title: phyteuma corniculatum
intro: Phyteuma corniculatum, commonly known as corn lily or ragged robin, is a perennial plant species belonging to the Campanulaceae family. It is valued for its medicinal properties and has been traditionally used to treat various health conditions. The plant is said to have anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which contribute to its therapeutic actions in soothing digestive issues, reducing fever, and promoting wound healing. The bioactive constituents present in Phyteuma corniculatum include flavonoids, saponins, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its health benefits and medicinal properties.
